static_traits.name: Liu Wei
static_traits.social_status: Good relationships with friends (shared anime interest); has not yet discussed learning troubles with friends; interpersonal life not yet visibly affected.
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior psychotherapy or psychological problem history.
static_traits.language_features: Clear and organized expression, able to provide specific examples; willing to cooperate with self-reflection, positive attitude.

basic_info.main_problem: Having difficulty remembering simple kanji when learning Japanese, and thus believing 'I will never remember any Japanese' when needed.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent difficulty learning Japanese and the accompanying negative thoughts cause significant pain and frustration, prompting them to seek counseling; they clearly state 'I am willing to work hard to change this pattern' and 'I look forward to making progress'.
growth_experiences: After starting to learn Japanese in college, gradually developed difficulty remembering simple kanji; failures recalling vocabulary and characters became more obvious when watching anime without subtitles, with negative anticipation and frustration gradually intensifying.

In a fight, I achieved victory, but still persistently attend to the negative detail of being hit in the abdomen; since then, whenever I achieve something (such as completing a project and being praised by the manager), I tend to be dominated by a few mistakes and find it hard to enjoy success.

core_beliefs: I am not capable enough (I am not as capable as others think)

special_situations.event: Encountering situations of failing to remember simple kanji and vocabulary in Japanese classes or self-study
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot even remember simple kanji, it means I am not capable enough, and will not remember when needed in the future.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Extra practice, using various memory techniques and flashcards to compensate for insufficiency.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never remember any Japanese.

special_situations.event: After winning a fight, still thinks about the detail of being hit in the abdomen
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any mistake or hit means the overall performance is poor, and the victory is not worth celebrating.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly ruminating on mistakes, ignoring the positive parts, reinforcing self-criticism.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am actually not good enough; this victory is nothing to be happy about.

special_situations.event: Completed a work project and received the manager's praise
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any error in the process proves I am incompetent and incapable.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring positive feedback, emphasizing error details, negating positive results.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as capable as everyone thinks.

special_situations.event: Frequent recall failures (vocabulary and characters) when watching anime without subtitles
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One memory failure means failure in the future too.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowers expectations, avoids discussing troubles with friends to avoid being evaluated.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as capable; to allow herself to enjoy achievements and positive feedback with peace of mind
core_conflict.fear: Fearing others will discover one's insufficiency and face negation or questioning
defense_goal: Avoiding exposing weaknesses through persistent self-criticism and high caution, preventing failure and negation

object_relations.self_representation: Not capable enough, someone needing constant correction
object_relations.object_representation: Others (e.g., superiors, peers) imagined as harsh judges who will pick out mistakes and negate oneself at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others emphasize one's successes, give affirmation, or invite focusing on the positive side
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing the other as a judge who may discover one's insufficiency, believing small mistakes completely negate ability (transference: seeing others as harsh fault-finders)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use an empathic and supportive tone; specifically and gently invite them to describe present feelings and positive evidence; encourage brief pauses and breathing, use non-judgmental wording, helping them view mistakes and achievements in balance.

manifestations: Hard to enjoy victory and achievement; success is overshadowed by a few negative details
Overall view of life tends negative, hard to feel satisfied
outcomes: Sense of achievement and decline in sense of well-being

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequent self-blaming self-talk (e.g., 'I am not as capable as people think')
Cautious when facing praise and hard to accept positive information
Not yet discussing learning troubles with supportive friends, suppressing support-seeking behavior

Clearly expresses willingness to put in effort to change patterns and looks forward to progress
Has completed work projects and been praised by the manager, objective ability evidence exists

Academics not yet visibly affected, basic functioning stable
negative_force: Significant cognitive distortions (mental filtering, negating the positive, overgeneralization, predicting the future, personalization)
Black-and-white evaluation of mistakes and perfectionist tendencies
Not yet actively seeking peer support, leaving resources unutilized
Increased stress and frustration, affecting daily life (especially watching anime)
Easily triggered into catastrophizing and Self-denial when watching without subtitles and facing recall failures

target_behavior.consequence: Increased stress and dissatisfaction, difficulty enjoying success, decreased life satisfaction.
